stem:
The table shows a comparison of muscle cells and blood cells.

Patterns of Gene Expression

| Genes For        | Muscle Cells | Blood Cells             |
|------------------|--------------|------------------------|
|                  |              | White      | Red (Immature)  |
| Glycolysis enzymes | On           | On         | On             |
| Muscle proteins    | On           | Off        | Off            |
| Glucagon          | Off          | Off        | Off            |
| Hemoglobin        | Off          | Off        | On             |

Based on the table, which conclusion can be made?

options.label: A
options.text: The gene that codes for glucagon is active only in muscle cells.

options.label: B
options.text: The gene that codes for hemoglobin is absent from blood cells.

options.label: C
options.text: The factors that regulate gene expression for muscle proteins are active in red and white blood cells.

options.label: D
options.text: The factors that regulate gene expression for glycolysis enzymes are active in muscle and blood cells.

visual_elements: table: Patterns of Gene Expression comparing Muscle Cells with Blood Cells (White and Red Immature) for genes Glycolysis enzymes, Muscle proteins, Glucagon, Hemoglobin.
